Define an equal-area analysis grid

cl_grid.Rd

Define an equal-area analysis grid

Usage

cl_grid(res = NULL, crs = NULL, extent = "global")

Arguments

res

Cell size in metres. Common choices are 100000 for global overviews, 25000 for continental analysis and 5000 for regional work.

crs

EPSG code of the equal-area CRS. Only 6933 is supported by the built-in closed-form projection; other codes require sf.

extent

Either "global" or a numeric vector c(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) in degrees.

Value

An object of class cl_grid.

Examples

g <- cl_grid(res = 100000)
g
#> <cl_grid> EPSG:6933
#>   resolution : 1e+05 m (cell area 10,000 km2)
#>   dimensions : 148 rows x 348 cols = 51,504 cells
#>   extent     : -180, -90, 180, 90 (degrees)
nrow(cl_grid_cells(g)) > 0
#> [1] TRUE
